title: Tech Note: Drag and Drop with Grouped or Logically Linked Arrays

historical_commentary.text: This note examines using 4D V6's then-new Drag and Drop capability to reorder items in and across arrays, including grouped arrays and arrays whose ordering must stay synchronized with additional hidden arrays; the specific classic-array-based UI drag-and-drop model has been superseded by decades of subsequent 4D form/list improvements, though the general idea of coordinating multiple linked data structures during reordering remains a recognizable UI engineering concern.
related_updates: 4D's Drag and Drop and list/array handling in forms have evolved substantially since V6, including modern list box and collection-based UI components
Classic parallel-array UI patterns (multiple arrays kept in sync by position) are less common in modern 4D development, which favors object/collection-based data structures
